description: A guinea pig sits in a small wire cage on a worn wooden bench, lit by a single desk lamp. Behind it, glass Erlenmeyer flasks with clear liquid and a glass syringe rest on a cloth. A white lab coat hangs on a hook at right, and several small wire cages sit on shelves in the dim background, each holding a rodent. The scene is a dark, oil-painted laboratory interior with no people and no visible text.
